# T-6: Separate auto and gate boundaries

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Keep auto-check as flow-start eligibility with temporary goal hard gate, and keep gate-draft as structural residual validation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- auto-check AI schema includes temporary goal but persisted autoCheck does not.
- Goal-missing auto-check returns eligible=false regardless of score.
- Persisted autoCheck contains a non-goal trust marker and non-secret input binding proving the goal gate ran for the current request/issue before set-auto may trust it.
- Spec-approved skipped auto-check verdicts contain a distinct skip trust marker plus approval binding and remain trusted by set-auto only while that binding matches.
- set-step autoUpgradeReeval uses the same goalGate marker contract.
- prepare-spec validates inherited preparing autoCheck markers before copying autoApprove state.
- request and issue mutations invalidate persisted autoCheck, autoApprove, autoDesired, and autoUpgrade trust state.
- FlowStore request/issue mutation helpers enforce auto trust invalidation for all callers.
- prepare request/issue overrides invalidate inherited preparing autoCheck, autoApprove, autoDesired, and autoUpgrade trust state.
- set-init prepared issueBody carries a source descriptor and is refreshed or dropped when final prepare inputs differ.
- auto-check input binding uses resolve-auto-check-input final normalized text and issue-body-cache or issue.md source descriptors.
- gate-draft uses fixed banned tokens for residual ambiguity and lightweight remediation semantics.
- The two new draft review command ids resolve independently and are not satisfied by the old command id.
- Agent profile documentation records this exact-match exception to the general prefix rule.
- FlowManager/agent automatic metrics store public phase draft plus optional concrete stepId for split draft review stages.

## Implementation Notes
Update src/flow/lib/run-auto-check.js, src/flow/lib/resolve-auto-check-input.js, src/flow/lib/issue-body-cache.js, src/flow/lib/set-auto.js, src/flow/lib/set-step.js, src/flow/lib/set-request.js, src/flow/lib/set-issue.js, src/flow/lib/set-init.js, src/flow/lib/run-prepare-spec.js, src/lib/preparing-flow-store.js, src/lib/flow-manager.js, src/lib/agent.js, src/lib/types.js, run-gate draft checks, and guardrail text. Do not switch active flow mode mid-flow when auto-check fails. Older persisted eligible autoCheck results without the marker, without an input binding, with a stale spec approval binding, or whose input binding no longer matches request/issue overrides, must be ignored or rechecked in both active-flow and preparing-flow trust paths.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for auto-check composition and gate-draft residual token failures; agent fixture for goal-missing auto-check output.
